formulas.absolute_weighted_score: sum((criterion score / max score) x criterion weight); 0-100
formulas.criterion_benchmark: highest validated score for the criterion across all evaluated suppliers
formulas.criterion_gap: supplier score - benchmark score (0 for the leader, otherwise negative)
formulas.relative_performance_pct: supplier score / benchmark x 100; 0 for everyone if the benchmark is 0
formulas.tie_break_order: 1) higher PPI 2) earlier submission date 3) higher experience rating 4) supplier name A-Z
